description:
An app inspector for use with an Appium server


(note: macOS artifacts are taken from 2026.11.5 due to a publishing error - they would be functionally identical anyway)
Highlights
- No functional changes, only platform compatibility
- The Windows desktop app is now signed and should no longer be blocked by Windows Defender
  - macOS notarization has been fixed since 2026.11.5
- The plugin version is now compatible with both Appium 3 and 4 installations
What's Changed
🚀 New Features
- feat(plugin): allow installing on Appium 4 by @y-schwab in #3344
📖 Documentation
- docs: tune macOS install instructions by @eglitise in #3342
- docs: tune display switcher requirements by @eglitise in #3343
- docs: tune Appium 4-related info by @eglitise in #3349
🔍 Other Changes
- ci: re-enable Windows signing with Azure OIDC login by @ryanaslett in #3345
New Contributors
- @y-schwab made their first contribution in #3344
- @ryanaslett made their first contribution in #3345
Full Changelog: v2026.11.5...v2026.11.6
